title: Authenticate named trigger captures and retries
changes: Bind named search dispatch and capture metadata to the exact enabled trigger name, session and definition hash; the executing runtime rechecks the action and refuses changed, disabled or forged definitions.
Add explicit named-trigger retry using the original run, request ID and deadline through the idempotent ledger; show the named identity in live pending context.
validation: Windows GNU default and audit-feature builds passed; 50 default and 53 feature Wine tests passed, including altered action and definition refusal, old capability refusal, named retry deduplication and search/recipe regressions.

An isolated EUR Wine/Xvfb session verified a guard/freeze, a frame-boundary capture carrying the exact named definition hash, and a retry returning identical JSON without advancing state or creating another snapshot. A separate verified 480x360 Win32 console displayed the name, full hash and extended pending parameters and cancelled the exact request. Protected inputs stayed unchanged and GUIs closed normally.
A shared Wine lease was owned by another validation; the initial test launch started no test and was retried after release.
limitations: DBG2-24 remains waiting for the partial DBG2-15 dependency. Audit-feature watch counting remains synthetic; native Windows, physical input and other ROMs were not tested. Private proof copies are retained.
